read.thesis: Asset-light hotel franchisor beat Q1 RevPAR guidance at +4.2% with a record 618k-room pipeline, but FY26 RevPAR guide trimmed to 2-3% on Middle East disruption and net rooms growth held at 4.5-5%.

triggers.label: Q1 RevPAR +4.2% beat
triggers.quote: Global RevPAR increased over 4 percent, exceeding the high end of our expectations
triggers.highlight: exceeding the high end of our expectations

triggers.label: FY26 RevPAR guide 2-3%
triggers.quote: Full Year 2026 Comparable systemwide constant $ RevPAR growth Worldwide 2.0% to 3.0%

triggers.label: Pipeline record 618k rooms
triggers.quote: Our industry-leading pipeline expanded to nearly 618,000 rooms, up over 5 percent from the year‐ago quarter
